evidence: Two informal sentences ('Users should be able to...') with no IDs, ACs or structure
No story format, no 'shall' statements, no sections

requirements.text: A user who forgot their password can reset it
The new password must be strong

clarifications.question: How does a user reset the password: emailed reset link, emailed one-time code, SMS code, or security questions?
clarifications.why: The whole flow (steps and expected results) depends on the mechanism; nothing is stated.

clarifications.question: What is the password policy for the new password (min/max length, required character classes, can it equal the previous password)?
clarifications.why: 'Strong' is not testable; boundary and validation cases need exact rules.

clarifications.question: What does 'secure' require: link/code expiry time, single use, invalidation of older links, rate limiting of reset requests?
clarifications.why: Each of these is a separate expected result; without values no security case can be verified.

clarifications.question: What should happen when the reset is requested for an email that is not registered?
clarifications.why: Determines whether a generic message (no account enumeration) or an error is expected.
